currentContext.expansion: The annual report contains no named expansion project, commissioning timeline or capacity-addition programme. The only forward capacity language is the Chairman's stated strategic vision: 'We aim to expand our manufacturing capacity, invest in advanced technologies, and strengthen our presence in both domestic and international markets' — with no project, site, size, cost or date attached. On the existing base, the MD&A states only that the Company is 'presently equipped with such a manufacturing facility capable of producing CPP & CPE films spanning a thickness range from 15 to 250 microns' (a product specification, not an installed capacity). Management describes the year's operating response as cost optimisation, improving operational efficiencies and 'enhancing capacity utilization' rather than adding capacity, and the technology-absorption disclosure notes only process development work to improve production efficiency and yield on existing products. The Board explicitly states that no capital investment was made on energy-conservation equipment during the financial year, that R&D expenditure was 'None', and that no technology was imported. Post year-end corporate actions (an increase in authorised share capital and the addition of agro/agri/food products to the Main Objects, both approved at the EGM of 27 June 2026) may enable future investment, but no capex plan is disclosed against them.
